params.name: summary
params.description: When `true`, include a human-readable `summary` field in the response.

items.docs: Look up reputation, suspiciousness, references, and detailed intelligence signals for an email address. Returns a `reputation` of `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none`, a boolean `suspicious` flag, a `references` count, and a `details` block covering blacklisting, malicious activity, credential leaks, data breaches, domain reputation, deliverability, MX validity, SPF/DMARC posture, spoofability, free-provider/disposable classification, and online profile observations. Use `summary=true` to addition
